AWPTCM-T43855.objective:
• IPv4 static routes are supported and can be configured on the device.
  • Configured IPv4 static routes are visible in show commands and used for unicast traffic forwarding.
  • IPv4 static routes function correctly during power cycle and rolling reboot scenarios (convergence and forwarding maintained).

steps.description: Note: Related ART Tests linked in Traceability. Primary: AWP-24184 (Check IPv4 static routes supported). Top relevant: AWP-7681 (IPv4 Static Routes - Unicast Traffic), AWP-25826 (ECMP for IPv4), AWP-20439 (Field Issue IPv4 multicast static). ART: 1330.4001.1 (static routes power_cycle), 1330.4001.7 (rolling_reboot) + related routing (1335/1355 for IPv4 static/ECMP).
Configure IPv4 static routes and verify they are accepted and shown in running-config and show ip route.
Verify unicast traffic forwards correctly using the static routes (e.g. ping or traffic test).
Test during power cycle and rolling reboot; confirm routes converge and traffic continues.
